title: William Tell
description: 1959. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. Trapped on an island owned by Prince Erik, a man who enjoys hunting prey, Tell's careers appears to be at the end.

title: Object Z
description: 1965. Stars Margaret Neale, Denys Peek & Trevor Bannister. Scientists around the world announce that a meteor will hit Earth in six weeks.

title: William at the Circus
description: Episode 1. 1948. Stars William Graham, Garry Marsh & Jane Welsh. William Brown begins to devise a plan to secure more pay and shorter hours for schoolboys.

title: Venture Adventure
description: 1941. A short film encouraging young men to enlist in the Army Training Corps, which was set up to train men in aviation skills, navigation and general duties for entry into the RAF.

title: Hawkeye & the Last of the Mohicans
description: 1957. Directed by Sam Newfield. Stars John Hart, Lon Chaney Jr & Bill Walsh. A series of thefts are falsely attributed to the innocent.

title: The Lone Ranger
description: 1949. Stars: Clayton Moore, Jay Silverheels & Sheila Ryan. Pete and Pedro don't like working, until the Lone Ranger persuades them to help an attractive young woman save her ranch.

title: Supercar
description: 1961. Stars David Graham, George Murcell & Graydon Gould. On the way to the South Pole, an uncontrolled force lands them on a strange island where they are in danger.

title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
description: 1957. Stars Richard Greene, Alexander Gauge & Hugh McDermott. King Richard sends Robin Hood and Friar Tuck on a mission to Scotland to collect a debt in the form of gold.

title: Target Earth
description: 1954. Sci-Fi. Directed by Sherman A. Rose. Starring Richard Denning. A large city is ordered to be completely evacuated as an army of robots, believed to be from the planet Venus, attack it.

title: Gift Horse
description: 1952. Director: Compton Bennett. Stars Trevor Howard, Richard Attenborough, Sonny Tufts. In 1940, the Captain of an old Royal Navy destroyer struggles with his crew, as well as the Nazis.

title: Scales of Justice
description: The Material Witness. Stars Edgar Lustgarten & John Carlin. A young executive plots to replace a firm's manager, and turns him in to police as a drunk driver. (S1, E.

title: Call Northside 777
description: 1948. Drama. Directed by Henry Hathaway. Stars James Stewart, Richard Conte & Helen Walker. A Chicago reporter looks into an old murder and realises the man jailed for the crime is innocent.

title: Dick Turpin
description: 1982. Stars Richard O'Sullivan & Ken Wynne. Swiftnick helps two lads who have been tricked into joining the King's army. The recruiting officers double back to get revenge.

title: Maigret
description: 1961. Stars Rupert Davies, Ewen Solon & Joseph Furst. Maigret travels to a coastal village to investigate the murder of the postmistress, with the schoolmaster being the main suspect.

title: Lillie
description: 1978. Stars Francesca Annis, Denis Lill & Ann Firbank. As Lillie acquires more admirers, her old friends see less of her, and she begins planning for the end of the season.

title: Unfaithfully Yours
description: 1984. Comedy. Directed by Howard Zieff. Stars Dudley Moore, Nastassja Kinski & Armand Assante. An orchestra conductor believes that his wife is cheating on him and concocts a plan to murder her.

title: Confessions from a Holiday Camp
description: 1977. Comedy. Directed by Norman Cohen. Stars Anthony Booth, Robin Askwith & Bill Maynard. Holiday camp employees enjoy their summer celebrations until a new manager arrives to spoil the fun.

title: EuroTrash
description: Hosted by Antoine de Caunes. We meet a Spanish siren with castanets, meet Finland's biggest slappers, Lolo dives deep down with her snorkel and one man goes down in medical history.

title: Yanky Panky
description: Join country music persona Tina C as she uncovers the eccentric subcultures, bizarre personalities, and the rude, crude and lewd underbelly of American society.

title: The Hitch-Hiker
description: 1953. Thriller. Director Ida Lupino. Stars Edmond O'Brien, Frank Lovejoy & William Talman. Ray & Gilbert's fishing trip takes a turn when they pick up a hitch-hiker who turns out to be on the run.

title: The Day Time Ended
description: 1979. Sci-Fi. Director: John Cardos. Stars Jim Davis, Christopher Mitchum & Dorothy Malone. Aliens visit the house of a family. The house is sucked into a time warp that sends it back in time.

title: One Step Beyond
description: Stars Philip Bourneuf & Anna Lee. After a young girl recovers from scarlet fever, she rejects her parents and insists she is the recently deceased daughter of another family.

title: Down Among The Z Men
description: 1952. Comedy directed by Maclean Rogers and starring Michael Bentine, Harry Secombe, Spike Milligan and Peter Sellers. Prof. Pureheart loses a secret formula in the grocery shop.

title: Scotland Yard
description: The Unseeing Eye. Directed by Geoffrey Muller. Starring Russell Napier, John Stone and Denny Dayviss. A night worker returning home sees smoke and flames coming from a building. (S1, E.

title: Sherlock Holmes
description: The Case of the Split Ticket. 1954. Starring: Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford & Archie Duncan. When O'Casey wins the lottery, they must find Albert before the ticket runs out.

title: The Brave Don't Cry
description: 1952. Drama. Directed by Philip Leacock. Starring John Gregson, Meg Buchanan & John Rae. Based on a true story. In a small Scots mining-town, a mine cave-in seals the entire crew.

title: X The Unknown
description: 1956. Fantasy. Directed by Leslie Norman. Stars Dean Jagger, Edward Chapman & Leo McKern. A radioactive creature terrorises a remote Scottish village, will anyone be able to stop it.

title: North West Frontier
description: 1959. Drama. Director: J. Lee Thompson. Stars Kenneth More, Lauren Bacall & Herbert Lom. In British India, a prince must be taken to safety across a rebel-held territory.

title: Water World
description: 2000. Actor and canal enthusiast Timothy West narrates the story of the incredible engineering feats needed to build canals and meets some of the characters to be found on inland waterways today.

title: That's My Boy
description: 1985. Stars Mollie Sugden, Deddie Davies & Eric Francis. Ida drops hints about what she wants for her upcoming birthday, but when it arrives she ends up disappointed.

title: For the Love of Ada
description: Stars: Wilfred Pickles, Irene Handl & Jack Smethurst. Ada is about to become a grandmother but when Ruth's baby arrives, Leslie is at first nowhere to be found. (S4, E.

title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
description: 1966. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & Larry Blyden. THRUSH has a mole inside New York headquarters. Solo and Kuryakin are assigned to root out the double agent.

title: The Footage Detectives
description: This week's first stop is Piccadilly Roundabout in 1944 wartime London, there's a slice of history from a bread factory in 1966, a reel of 1950s Italy and a look at the history of Baxter's.

title: Enemy At The Door
description: 1978. Stars: Alfred Burke, Bernard Horsfall. Dr. Martel arranges hospitalisation for frail old Mrs. Bree who, with her son Edward, are rent-free tenants of Peter.

title: Jigsaw
description: 1962. Directed by Val Guest and starring Jack Warner. A woman is murdered and it's up to Detective Fellows to sift through the clues and solve the 'Jigsaw'. Great shots of Brighton in the 60s.

title: Fox
description: 1980. Stars Bernard Hill, Mary Peach & Lee Walker. Vin tries to sort out his finances so he can buy a country pub. Ray is also offered a good business proposition.

title: An Innocent Man
description: 1989. Crime Drama. Directed by Peter Yates. Stars Tom Selleck, F. Murray Abraham & Laila Robins. Two corrupt cops send an innocent man to prison, leading him to seek revenge on his release.

title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
description: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.
